summary: Assess systemic risk indicators, compare macroprudential policy options and prepare decision briefs. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Macroprudential regulation and oversight use policy measures to identify and address risks that can spread across the financial system. For financial-stability analysts and prudential-policy teams, the work involves interpreting indicators, checking data quality and mapping transmission channels across banks and non-bank finance. The course develops a structured approach to comparing policy options and preparing decision briefs that explain the evidence, its limitations and potential follow-up actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who monitor system-wide financial vulnerabilities, advise on prudential measures or prepare financial-stability decisions and reporting.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with financial-sector balance sheets, banking or insurance risk, or prudential policy is recommended. No coding is required. The analytical exercises use indicators and illustrative data at an operational review level; advanced model development is outside the course scope.
